title: SpriteStage: Long Horizon Animation Generation via Progressive Scene Programming and Replay
title_zh: SpriteStage：通过渐进式场景编程与回放实现长时程动画生成

paragraphs.en: Video generation models synthesize visual sequences from text and image inputs. Extending video generation to long animations requires actions, dialogue, camera coverage, and narrative developments to remain coordinated across scenes. Executable scene programs make these decisions available for inspection. Constructing an entire story before observing its execution can leave later scenes dependent on unrealized events. We present SpriteStage, a progressive scene programming framework that builds animation through iterative enactment and engine reorchestration. Iterative enactment generates each scene from an accepted world checkpoint and narrative snapshot, executes it on a shared spatial stage, and uses runtime and visual feedback to revise the relevant actions or story beats. The accepted outcome becomes the starting state for the next scene. Engine reorchestration maps the resulting draft to production assets and engine capabilities while retaining its events, geometry, and timing. Inspection of the assembled sequence and frozen replay carry the accepted performance into the final video. Three complete animations, ranging from approximately 9.9 to 14.3 minutes, demonstrate the framework’s effectiveness in producing extended narratives through scene programming and engine execution.
paragraphs.zh: 视频生成模型从文本和图像输入合成视觉序列。 将视频生成扩展到长动画，需要动作、对话、镜头覆盖和情节发展在各个场景之间保持协调。 可执行的场景程序使这些决策可供检查。 在观察执行结果之前构建完整的故事，可能导致后续场景依赖于未实现的事件。 我们提出 SpriteStage，一个通过迭代演绎和引擎重编排来构建动画的渐进式场景编程框架。 迭代演绎从一个已被接受的世界检查点和叙事快照生成每个场景，在共享的空间舞台上执行它，并利用运行时和视觉反馈来修订相关动作或故事节拍。 被接受的结果成为下一个场景的起始状态。 引擎重编排将得到的草稿映射到生产资产和引擎能力，同时保留其事件、几何和时间。 对组装好的序列进行检查以及冻结回放，将已被接受的演出带入最终视频。 三个完整动画，时长约从 9.9 分钟到 14.3 分钟，展示了该框架通过场景编程和引擎执行生成长篇叙事的有效性。

paragraphs.en: Video generation models such as Seedance 1.0, Wan, and HunyuanVideo have advanced visual quality, motion synthesis, and control from text prompts [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] . Computational budgets constrain the spatial and temporal extent of a single generation, and direct video synthesis continues to face challenges in maintaining coherence and dependencies over longer intervals [ 4 ] . Programs and simulation offer a complementary approach to video creation: reusable assets and explicit story orchestration define the content, and execution produces the frames [ 5 , 6 ] . With fixed assets, programs, and execution configuration, deterministic playback makes the effects of production decisions available for inspection and revision. In a long animation, these effects also shape the story. A character who acquires a key carries it into later interactions, while information conveyed in dialogue can motivate a subsequent reaction. The camera and timing make these developments visible to the audience. Coordinating world state, character behavior, dialogue, and framing across an entire animation therefore requires understanding what each scene actually enacts. When all scenes are generated together, a missed handoff or an unfinished interaction can leave later scenes dependent on an event that the audience never sees.
paragraphs.zh: Seedance 1.0、Wan 和 HunyuanVideo 等视频生成模型在视觉质量、动作合成以及基于文本提示的控制方面取得了进展 [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] 。 计算预算限制了单次生成的空间和时间范围，直接视频合成在更长时间间隔上保持连贯性和依赖关系方面仍面临挑战 [ 4 ] 。 程序与仿真为视频创作提供了一种互补的方法：可复用的资产和显式的情节编排定义内容，而执行则生成画面帧 [ 5 , 6 ] 。 在资产、程序和执行配置固定的情况下，确定性回放使得制作决策的效果可供检查和修改。 在一部长动画中，这些效果还会进一步塑造故事。 一个获得钥匙的角色会把它带入后续的互动，而对话中传达的信息可以引发后续的反应。 镜头和时序让观众能够看到这些情节的发展。 因此，在整个动画中协调世界状态、角色行为、对话和取景，需要理解每个场景实际演绎的内容。 当所有场景一起生成时，一次遗漏的交接或未完成的互动，可能使后续场景依赖于观众从未见过的事件。

paragraphs.en: Temporal conditioning and streaming extend video generation through visual context at multiple timescales, persistent memory, and training for longer autoregressive rollouts [ 7 , 8 , 9 ] . Planning across scenes organizes recurring entities, scene descriptions, and spatial layouts [ 10 ] . Executable generation exposes the actions and timing behind a sequence. Code2Video combines outlines and storyboards with code synthesis, scoped refinement, and visual feedback [ 5 ] , while spatiotemporal verification and engine feedback guide iterative animation generation [ 6 , 11 ] . Sustaining a narrative across scenes also requires the realized outcome of each scene to guide the next. Execution establishes which interactions occur, where characters end up, and what the audience can observe. Revising a scene can change these outcomes and the assumptions available to later scenes. This dependence calls for a representation linking spatial and narrative state, together with a repair process that revises the relevant actions or story beats while retaining satisfactory content.
paragraphs.zh: 时间条件化与流式生成通过多时间尺度的视觉上下文、持久记忆以及针对更长自回归推演的训练来扩展视频生成 [7, 8, 9]。 跨场景规划对重复出现的实体、场景描述和空间布局进行组织 [10]。 可执行的生成揭示了序列背后的动作与时序。 Code2Video 将大纲和分镜与代码合成、范围受限的细化以及视觉反馈相结合 [5]，而时空验证与引擎反馈则引导迭代式动画生成 [6, 11]。 在场景之间维持叙事连贯，还要求每个场景的最终实现结果能够指导下一个场景。 执行确定了哪些交互会发生、角色最终处于何处，以及观众能够观察到什么。 修改一个场景可能会改变这些结果，以及后续场景可用的假设。 这种依赖性要求一种将空间状态与叙事状态关联起来的表示，同时还需要一个修复过程，在保留满意内容的同时修正相关的动作或故事节拍。

paragraphs.en: We propose SpriteStage, a framework for long horizon animation generation with two modules: iterative enactment and engine reorchestration . Iterative enactment generates, executes, and inspects each scene from accepted spatial and narrative states. Feedback locates actions or story beats for revision, and local repair retains the surrounding performance. Each accepted scene advances the world and narrative states, allowing the draft to grow from realized outcomes. Engine reorchestration carries this draft into production. Its story, events, geometry, and shared clock guide the mapping of assets, actions, camera cues, and sound to the selected engine. Engine observations guide presentation revisions, and inspection of the assembled animation addresses continuity and timing across scenes. Final rendering replays the frozen production with the accepted story and temporal organization.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出SpriteStage，一个用于长时程动画生成的框架，包含两个模块：迭代演绎和引擎重编排。 迭代演绎基于已接受的空间状态和叙事状态来生成、执行并检查每个场景。 反馈机制定位需要修订的动作或故事节拍，而局部修复会保留周围的表演。 每个被接受的场景都会推进世界状态和叙事状态，使草稿能够从已实现的结果中逐步生长。 引擎重编排将这份草稿带入制作阶段。 草稿中的故事、事件、几何信息和共享时钟引导资产、动作、镜头提示和音效到所选引擎的映射。 引擎观察结果指导呈现层面的修订，而对组装完成动画的检查则处理跨场景的连续性与时序问题。 最终渲染以被接受的故事和时间组织形式回放冻结的制作内容。

paragraphs.en: Our contributions are threefold: (1) an iterative enactment algorithm based on spatial state transitions that conditions scene generation on accepted world and narrative outcomes and uses execution feedback for local repair; (2) a harness for long video generation that connects draft enactment, engine reorchestration, sequence inspection, and frozen replay; and (3) three generated animation videos that demonstrate the effectiveness of the method.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献有三个方面：（1）一种基于空间状态转移的迭代执行算法，将场景生成条件化于已接受的世界与叙事结果之上，并利用执行反馈进行局部修复；（2）一个用于长视频生成的工具框架，连接草稿执行、引擎重新编排、序列检查与冻结回放；（3）三个生成的动画视频，证明了该方法的有效性。

paragraphs.en: Seedance 1.0 jointly models video generation from text and images and supports sequences with multiple shots [ 1 ] . Wan combines diffusion transformers with a spatiotemporal variational autoencoder and scalable training for video generation conditioned on text or images [ 2 ] . HunyuanVideo scales an open video foundation model through data curation, architecture design, and progressive training [ 3 ] . StreamingT2V uses conditioning at short and long timescales to autoregressively extend videos while maintaining transitions and appearance [ 7 ] . LongLive combines causal generation at the frame level, key and value recaching, and streaming long tuning for interactive synthesis of long videos [ 8 ] . LoL introduces rotary position embedding jitter across attention heads to mitigate attention sink collapse during long horizon streaming generation [ 9 ] .
paragraphs.zh: Seedance 1.0 联合建模从文本和图像出发的视频生成，并支持包含多个镜头的序列 [1]。 Wan 将扩散 Transformer 与时空变分自编码器以及可扩展训练相结合，实现以文本或图像为条件的视频生成 [2]。 HunyuanVideo 通过数据整理、架构设计和渐进式训练，扩展出一个开放的视频基础模型 [3]。 StreamingT2V 利用短时间尺度和长时间尺度上的条件机制，以自回归方式扩展视频，同时保持过渡和外观 [7]。 LongLive 结合帧级因果生成、键值重缓存和流式长程微调，实现长视频的交互式合成 [8]。 LoL 引入跨注意力头的旋转位置编码抖动，以缓解长程流式生成中的注意力汇聚坍塌问题 [9]。

paragraphs.en: VideoDirectorGPT plans entities, layouts, and consistency information across scenes to guide video synthesis [ 10 ] . Code2Video combines outlines and storyboards with executable code synthesis, scoped refinement, and visual feedback for educational video production [ 5 ] . GPT4Motion generates Blender scripts for physical motion simulation and uses the resulting structural information to condition video generation with diffusion models [ 12 ] . MoVer expresses spatiotemporal properties of motion graphics in first order logic and returns failed predicates to a language model for iterative repair [ 6 ] . StoryBlender combines a continuity memory graph, a unified coordinate space, and feedback verified by the engine to construct and refine 3D storyboards with consistency across shots [ 11 ] .
paragraphs.zh: VideoDirectorGPT 规划跨场景的实体、布局与一致性信息，以引导视频合成 [ 10 ] 。 Code2Venture 将大纲与分镜和可执行代码合成、范围化精修以及视觉反馈相结合，用于教育视频制作 [ 5 ] 。 GPT4Motion 生成用于物理运动模拟的 Blender 脚本，并利用所得的结构信息以扩散模型为条件进行视频生成 [ 12 ] 。 MoVer 用一阶逻辑表达动态图形的时空属性，并将未通过的谓词返回给语言模型进行迭代修复 [ 6 ] 。 StoryBlender 结合连续性记忆图、统一坐标空间以及由引擎验证的反馈，构建并精修具有跨镜头一致性的 3D 分镜 [ 11 ] 。

paragraphs.en: SpriteStage combines story decomposition with iterative enactment and engine reorchestration (Fig. 1 ). Given a user goal, character descriptions, and production requirements, the planner develops an outline across scenes and a timed script for the current scene. The framework executes and inspects that scene on a shared spatial stage, using the resulting feedback to guide revision. Accepted scenes form a draft whose story, spatial relationships, and realized timing guide asset preparation and engine production. Engine reorchestration presents this performance using the available visual and audio capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: SpriteStage 将故事分解与迭代推演和引擎重新编排相结合（图 1）。 给定用户目标、角色描述和制作要求，规划器会制定跨场景的大纲以及当前场景的定时剧本。 该框架在共享的空间舞台上执行并检视该场景，利用产生的反馈来指导修订。 通过审核的场景构成草稿，其故事、空间关系和已实现的时序会指导资产准备与引擎制作。 引擎重新编排利用可用的视觉和音频能力呈现这场表演。

paragraphs.en: The planner extracts the narrative intent from the user goal and develops a structured outline. Each scene specifies its setting, time context, participants, and narrative development. Character descriptions and dependencies across scenes provide persistent context: an acquired object or information revealed in dialogue affects later scenes. The outline establishes the story’s direction, and the executable details of each scene are developed after its predecessor has been accepted.
paragraphs.zh: 规划器从用户目标中提取叙事意图，并制定结构化大纲。 每个场景都指定其背景设定、时间上下文、参与者和叙事发展。 角色描述以及跨场景的依赖关系提供了持久上下文：在对话中获得的物品或揭示的信息会影响后续场景。 大纲确定了故事的方向，每个场景的可执行细节在其前一个场景被接受后再进行开发。

paragraphs.en: For the current scene, the planner produces timed story beats. Each beat combines a screenplay description with its participants, spoken text, intended result, timing cues, and dependencies on other beats. This representation connects narrative events, such as approaching a companion or handing over a key, to actions that can be executed and inspected. The structured plan is the source for the readable screenplay and subsequent action generation. Descriptions and asset requirements can also specify music and sound effects, which are bound to concrete audio cues during production.
paragraphs.zh: 对于当前场景，规划器生成带时间标记的故事节拍。 每个节拍将剧本描述与其参与者、台词、预期结果、时间提示以及对其他节拍的依赖关系结合在一起。 这种表示将叙事事件（例如接近同伴或交出钥匙）与可以执行和检查的动作联系起来。 结构化计划是可读剧本和后续动作生成的来源。 描述和资产需求还可以指定音乐和音效，它们会在制作过程中绑定到具体的音频提示上。

paragraphs.en: Timing cues establish the intended pacing. Execution refines this schedule using measured speech durations and action completion events, so a response can follow the actual end of a line or interaction. The plan thus connects narrative meaning to the temporal relationships that communicate it. Developing one scene at a time allows its script to incorporate the spatial and narrative outcomes of earlier enactments.
paragraphs.zh: 时间提示确立了预期的节奏。 执行阶段利用测得的语音时长和动作完成事件来细化这一时间表，因此一个回应可以跟随台词或交互的实际结束而进行。 因此，该计划将叙事意义与传达这些意义的时间关系联系了起来。 一次只开发一个场景，可以让该场景的剧本融入此前演绎所产生的空间与叙事结果。

paragraphs.en: Inspection combines runtime evidence with visual review in temporal order. The default filmstrip samples one frame per second and groups up to 24 frames per page, including the final partial page. A vision language model reads every page in order against the scene plan and prior narrative state. Runtime evidence describes timing, dependencies, and geometric relationships. Visual review examines the legibility of actions, camera coverage, and character reactions in their narrative context. Denser frame samples and motion observations support inspection of brief contacts and transitions. Findings link each issue to its time, entities, and story beat so that revision can target the relevant content.
paragraphs.zh: 检查将运行时证据与按时间顺序进行的视觉审查相结合。 默认的胶片条每秒采样一帧，每页最多分组24帧，包括最后一个不完整的页。 视觉语言模型按照场景计划和先前的叙事状态依序读取每一页。 运行时证据描述时序、依赖关系和几何关系。 视觉审查在叙事语境中考察动作的清晰度、镜头覆盖和角色反应。 更密集的帧采样和运动观察支持对短暂接触和过渡的检查。 发现结果将每个问题与其时间、实体和故事节拍关联起来，以便修订能够针对相关内容。

paragraphs.en: Character preparation connects draft geometry to production artwork. The framework assembles a transparent reference image on the original draft canvas and combines it with the character description, part structure, rig, and attachments to guide image editing. If the image model requires a different output size, transparent padding followed by cropping to the source rectangle retains the canvas scale and coordinates. Part decomposition and registration establish the geometry of the resulting artwork. Preparation on the original canvas uses polygons to separate visible parts and registers their joints, anchors, layer order, and rig bindings. Designated donor regions and masks supply hidden connections. Generating artwork within the frozen source part canvases retains the corresponding rig, anchor, layer, and facing mappings.
paragraphs.zh: 角色准备将草稿几何结构与成稿美术资源连接起来。 该框架在原始草稿画布上组装一张透明参考图像，并将其与角色描述、部件结构、绑定、附件结合，以指导图像编辑。 如果图像模型需要不同的输出尺寸，先进行透明填充再裁剪回源矩形，可以保持画布的缩放比例和坐标。 部件分解与登记确立了成稿美术资源的几何结构。 在原始画布上的准备工作使用多边形分离可见部件，并登记它们的关节、锚点、图层顺序和绑定关系。 指定的供体区域和遮罩提供隐藏的连接。 在冻结的源部件画布内生成美术资源，可以保留相应的绑定、锚点、图层和朝向映射。

paragraphs.en: Production binding associates the registered geometry of each part with its draft node and motion. Coordinate mappings between the world stage and the local rig carry actions into the prepared character while retaining the relationships used for contact and attachment. Binding requires corresponding parts and compatible facing configurations. Geometric registration and inspection establish whether the prepared character supports the intended motion. The performance is then baked into editable engine assets, including prefabs, animation clips, and timelines. These assets replay the accepted trajectories and timing.
paragraphs.zh: 生产绑定将每个部件的已注册几何体与其草稿节点和动作关联起来。 世界舞台与本地装置之间的坐标映射将动作带入准备好的角色，同时保留用于接触和附着的关系。 绑定要求部件相互对应且朝向配置兼容。 几何注册与检查用于确定准备好的角色是否支持预期的动作。 然后将表演烘焙为可编辑的引擎资源，包括预制体、动画剪辑和时间线。 这些资源回放已接受的轨迹和时序。

paragraphs.en: Audio preparation follows the same event structure. During import, a language model proposes uses, playback modes, tags, and descriptions from audio clip names. Users confirm these annotations before they enter the searchable index. The director queries the index by intended use, style, and description, then considers the selected resource alongside the relevant event and existing audio. Each cue specifies its resource, role, event interval, source offset, gain, and fades. Clip duration and resource type constrain segment selection and repeated playback, while the established voice track remains fixed. This process turns script requirements for music and sound effects into timed production assets.
paragraphs.zh: 音频准备遵循相同的事件结构。 导入时，语言模型根据音频剪辑名称提出用途、播放模式、标签和描述。 用户在进入可检索索引之前确认这些标注。 导演按预期用途、风格和描述查询索引，然后结合相关事件和现有音频来考量所选资源。 每个提示都指定其资源、角色、事件区间、源偏移、增益和淡入淡出。 剪辑时长和资源类型约束片段选择与重复播放，而已建立的语音轨保持固定。 这一过程将剧本对音乐和音效的要求转化为定时化的制作资源。

paragraphs.en: Engine execution and inspection of the assembled sequence examine visible interactions, continuity across scenes, camera coverage, and audio synchronization. Presentation revisions retain the accepted story and terminal scene states. Changes to facts used by later scenes propagate through the dependent scene chain. Once the production is accepted, the framework freezes asset bindings, motion, and timing. Final rendering replays this performance at the selected quality, carrying the inspected spatial and temporal organization into the output video.

paragraphs.en: We demonstrate SpriteStage through three complete animations: Sending Jingniang Home , Pinocchio , and The Empty City Stratagem . Sending Jingniang Home and Pinocchio contain eight and five narrative acts, respectively. The Empty City Stratagem develops two narrative acts across three executable scenes: the inner courtyard, the elevated instrument platform, and the road outside the gate. Each work combines dialogue, character movement, and staged interactions. Each video shows how scene programs organize a narrative into enacted events and how the resulting draft guides engine production.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过三个完整的动画来展示 SpriteStage：《送京娘》、《木偶奇遇记》和《空城计》。 《送京娘》和《木偶奇遇记》分别包含八个和五个叙事幕。 《空城计》在三个可执行场景中展开两个叙事幕：内院、高耸的器械平台和门外的大路。 每部作品都结合了对话、角色动作和舞台化互动。 每个视频展示了场景程序如何将叙事组织为可演绎的事件，以及生成的草稿如何指导引擎制作。

paragraphs.en: Narrative continuity across scenes is expressed through persistent objects, character knowledge, and recurring actions. The three animations span approximately 9.9 to 14.3 minutes, and the sequences in Fig. 3 form local developments within their longer story arcs. In Pinocchio , the schoolbook connects the father’s sacrifice, the child’s decision to attend the theatre, and his later concern about returning home. Selling it provides admission money, while its absence gives meaning to the final responsibility of carrying five coins to his father. The Empty City Stratagem connects preparation to interpretation across two acts and three executable scenes. Opening the gates, clearing the entrance, and resuming ordinary sweeping establish the conditions subsequently observed by Sima Yi and Sima Zhao. Their competing interpretations, investigation, and withdrawal follow from those conditions, and a report communicates the outcome to the defenders. Sending Jingniang Home sustains the escort relationship through a journey, confession, homecoming, and loss. Looking back, waiting, and making room initially express practical care. The same gestures acquire a different meaning when the final solitary journey returns to an empty road. These connections show how retained narrative context gives later actions significance across changes of location, time, and participants.
paragraphs.zh: 叙事连贯性通过持续存在的物品、角色的认知以及反复出现的动作在场景之间得以体现。 三段动画的时长约为 9.9 至 14.3 分钟，图 3 中的片段构成了其更长故事弧中的局部发展。 在《木偶奇遇记》中，课本连接了父亲的牺牲、孩子决定去看戏，以及他后来对回家之路的担忧。 卖掉课本换来了门票钱，而课本的缺失则赋予了最终携带五枚硬币回家的责任以意义。 空城计通过两幕和三个可执行场景将准备与解读连接起来。 打开城门、清理入口并恢复日常扫洒，确立了随后由司马懿和司马昭观察到的条件。 他们相互竞争的解读、侦查以及撤退都由这些条件引出，而一份报告将结果传达给了守城者。 《千里送京娘》通过一段旅程、表白、归乡与离别，维系着护送关系。 回望、等候与让路最初表达的是实际的关怀。 当最后的孤独旅程回到空无一人的道路时，同样的动作获得了不同的含义。 这些联系表明，保留的叙事语境如何在地点、时间和参与者的变化中赋予后续动作以意义。

paragraphs.en: Articulated action and spatial orchestration turn these narrative dependencies into visible interactions. At the beginning of Sending Jingniang Home , an offscreen call leads through listening and movement to discovery of the captive. Opening the sliding cage panel and stepping aside establish her route out. The mountain encounter varies position, overhead and oblique attacks, staff defence, and counterattack, while Jingniang’s retreat and return connect the combat to the interrupted escort. Later, relative positions beneath the eaves express an offer of shelter, and approaches, turns, and gestures accompany changes in the relationship. In Pinocchio , a brief shared hold precedes the father’s release of the book. Inspection, payment, release, and ticket acquisition then develop the street transaction. Performers gathering around the child interrupt their play, while his later return from the exit toward a threatened companion expresses a change of intention. In The Empty City Stratagem , hinged gates expose a passage, the broom moves with its holder, and the weapon rests against a supporting surface. A standing approach leads into seated performance on the elevated platform, with camera changes connecting that position to the gate and approaching opponents. The Shadow Duel draft further isolates coordinated body and prop motion (Fig. 5 ): frames at 0, 2, 4, and 6 seconds move from separated poses to crossed weapons and a raised body pose. Across these examples, explicit geometry, attachment, and timing organize contact, ownership changes, movement, and group participation within a shared stage.
paragraphs.zh: 具身的动作与空间调度将这些叙事依赖关系转化为可见的互动。 在《送京娘》的开场，画外的呼唤通过聆听与移动引导至对被囚者的发现。 拉开滑动笼门并侧身让开，确立了京娘的出场路线。 山道遭遇战在站位上有所变化，包括头顶与斜向的攻击、持棍防御与反击，而京娘的后退与回归则将打斗与被打断的护送联系起来。 随后，屋檐下的相对位置表达了提供庇护之意，而接近、转身与手势则伴随着两人关系的变化。 在《匹诺曹》中，一个短暂的共同持握先于父亲松开书本。 检视、付款、放手以及取票随后展开了街头交易。 围拢到孩子身边的表演者打断了玩耍，而他后来从出口返回、冲向受威胁的同伴，则表达了意图的转变。 在《空城计》中，铰链式城门露出一条通道，扫帚随持帚者移动，而武器则倚靠在支撑面上。 站立行进引出在高台上的坐姿表演，镜头变化将这一位置与城门及逼近的对手联系起来。 《影斗》草稿进一步分离了协调的身体与道具运动（图5）：0、2、4、6秒处的画面从分离的姿态推进到交叉的兵刃与身体抬起的姿态。 在这些例子中，明确的几何关系、附着关系与时间安排在共享的舞台内组织了接触、归属变更、运动与群体参与。

sents.zh: 在《送京娘》的开场，画外的呼唤通过聆听与移动引导至对被囚者的发现。

sents.en: Opening the sliding cage panel and stepping aside establish her route out.
sents.zh: 拉开滑动笼门并侧身让开，确立了京娘的出场路线。

sents.en: The mountain encounter varies position, overhead and oblique attacks, staff defence, and counterattack, while Jingniang’s retreat and return connect the combat to the interrupted escort.

sents.en: Later, relative positions beneath the eaves express an offer of shelter, and approaches, turns, and gestures accompany changes in the relationship.
sents.zh: 随后，屋檐下的相对位置表达了提供庇护之意，而接近、转身与手势则伴随着两人关系的变化。

sents.en: In Pinocchio , a brief shared hold precedes the father’s release of the book.
sents.zh: 在《匹诺曹》中，一个短暂的共同持握先于父亲松开书本。

sents.en: Inspection, payment, release, and ticket acquisition then develop the street transaction.
sents.zh: 检视、付款、放手以及取票随后展开了街头交易。

sents.en: Performers gathering around the child interrupt their play, while his later return from the exit toward a threatened companion expresses a change of intention.
sents.zh: 围拢到孩子身边的表演者打断了玩耍，而他后来从出口返回、冲向受威胁的同伴，则表达了意图的转变。

sents.en: In The Empty City Stratagem , hinged gates expose a passage, the broom moves with its holder, and the weapon rests against a supporting surface.
sents.zh: 在《空城计》中，铰链式城门露出一条通道，扫帚随持帚者移动，而武器则倚靠在支撑面上。

sents.en: The Shadow Duel draft further isolates coordinated body and prop motion (Fig. 5 ): frames at 0, 2, 4, and 6 seconds move from separated poses to crossed weapons and a raised body pose.

sents.en: Across these examples, explicit geometry, attachment, and timing organize contact, ownership changes, movement, and group participation within a shared stage.
sents.zh: 在这些例子中，明确的几何关系、附着关系与时间安排在共享的舞台内组织了接触、归属变更、运动与群体参与。

paragraphs.en: Speech, mouth motion, subtitles, and music share the temporal organization of the performance. In Pinocchio and The Empty City Stratagem , recorded character and audio bindings associate each dialogue cue with a speaking entity and registered mouth part. Mouth opening and closing follow activity in the actual speech waveform, with silent intervals returning the mouth to its closed state. Gestures and listener reactions can occur alongside speech, while measured voice intervals supply timing for subtitles and subsequent actions. This coordination connects the visible speaker to the corresponding line in the exchanges between Sima Yi and Sima Zhao and among the puppets. Music also contributes to motivation and dramatic development. In Pinocchio , plucked phrases and sustained strings accompany anticipation and the gift of the book; theatre music then motivates the child’s change of direction. Changes in register and pacing accompany hesitation over the book, danger near the fire, the return to protect a companion, and farewell. Musical pauses leave room for the explanation about the father’s coat and the decision after the child’s offer of sacrifice. A metal sound at the placement of the fire tongs is anchored to the completion of that action. In The Empty City Stratagem , small alternating arm movements accompany short musical phrases, and the resulting apparent calm becomes part of what the opponents interpret. Sound therefore participates in both event realization and narrative progression.
paragraphs.zh: 语音、嘴部动作、字幕和音乐共享演出的时间组织。 在《匹诺曹》与《空城计》中，记录的角色与音频绑定将每条对话提示与一个发声实体及已登记的嘴部部件关联起来。 嘴部的开合跟随实际语音波形中的活动，静默区间则使嘴部回到闭合状态。 手势和听者反应可与语音同时发生，而经测量的语音区间为字幕及后续动作提供时间依据。 这种协调将可见的说话者与司马懿和司马昭之间以及木偶们之间的对话中的相应台词联系起来。 音乐同样有助于动机呈现与剧情发展。 在《匹诺曹》中，拨弦乐句与持续弦乐伴随期待之情与赠书一幕；随后剧场音乐推动了孩子的转向。 音区和节奏的变化伴随对书本的犹豫、火堆旁的危险、回来保护同伴以及告别。 音乐停顿为关于父亲外套的解释以及孩子提出牺牲后的决定留出空间。 放置火钳时的金属声与该动作的完成相锚定。 在《空城计》中，手臂小幅交替摆动伴随短小的音乐乐句，由此呈现出的表面平静成为对手解读的一部分。 因此，声音既参与事件的实现，也参与叙事的推进。

paragraphs.en: The separation of enactment and engine production supports changes in appearance and presentation around an established performance. The paired Pinocchio frames in Fig. 4 depict the gathering of the group, changes in its arrangement, and the later appearance of the theatre master at matched timestamps. Production supplies illustrated characters, detailed costumes, and revised framing around the draft’s progression. The common timeline relates these visual changes to the same organized actions and dialogue. The three complete works further present different visual treatments through a shared organization of scenes, event timing, character state, and audio. Together with the compact articulated interaction in Shadow Duel , they demonstrate how local action programs can be assembled into extended narratives and carried through to engine output.
paragraphs.zh: 排演与引擎制作的分离，支持在既定演出周围对外观和呈现进行更改。 图4中成对的匹诺曹画面在对应的时间戳上描绘了群体的聚集、其排列的变化，以及随后剧场师傅的出现。 制作过程围绕草稿的推进提供插图角色、精细服装和修订后的取景。 共同的时间线将这些视觉变化与相同的组织化动作和对话关联起来。 这三部完整作品通过共享的场景组织、事件时序、角色状态和音频，进一步呈现了不同的视觉处理。 加上 Shadow Duel 中紧凑的拟人化互动，它们展示了局部动作程序如何被组装成延展的叙事并传递到引擎输出。

paragraphs.en: We presented SpriteStage, a progressive scene programming framework that connects iterative enactment with engine reorchestration. Accepted world and narrative states guide each scene, while runtime and visual feedback locate actions and story beats for revision. The resulting draft supplies the events, spatial relationships, and timing for engine production and frozen replay. Three complete animations demonstrate this approach to constructing extended narratives from executable scenes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 SpriteStage，一个将迭代演绎与引擎重新编排相连接的渐进式场景编程框架。 已确认的世界状态与叙事状态引导每个场景，而运行时与视觉反馈则为修订定位动作与故事节拍。 所得到的草稿为引擎制作与冻结回放提供事件、空间关系与时间安排。 三个完整的动画展示了这种从可执行场景构建长篇叙事的方法。
